preconditions.description: The starting string must be non-empty.
The index n must be a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == start if n == 1 else (lambda seq: seq[n-1])([start] + [look_and_say(s) for s in [start] for _ in range(n-1)])
postconditions.description: The function returns the nth element of the sequence starting with 'start', where each subsequent element is generated by applying the look-and-say operation to the previous element.
The returned string consists only of digit characters.
